protocol.cache_h0: Compute first-observation state once; every later observation uses that same undetached state
protocol.ce7: Final seven-action logits versus native turn0/turn1 target
protocol.ce2: Final logits0:2 only; model retains seven output logits
protocol.fork_ablation: At final observation only: zero cached h0 or recursive current_only=True
protocol.training_data: Exact four balanced observable-teacher contexts selected by the unchanged earlier script
protocol.evaluation_data: Same four selected seed IDs at all sizes; not unseen unique maps
protocol.selection: Final checkpoint only; all three seeds; fixed budget; no early stopping or selection
protocol.state_distance: Mean Euclidean distance between opposite-cue pairs with the same upper branch
protocol.scope: Supervised choice optimization and forced-path length transfer, not gameplay or RL
